(function(){
 function normalizeCountColumns(){
  document.querySelectorAll(&#x27;table.excel-grid&#x27;).forEach(function(table){
   var cols=table.querySelectorAll(&#x27;colgroup col&#x27;);
   if(!cols.length)return;
   // Keep first two columns for row/grade labels; equalize all visible data columns.
   var visible=[];
   cols.forEach(function(col,i){
    if(i&lt;2)return;
    if(getComputedStyle(col).display===&#x27;none&#x27; || col.style.display===&#x27;none&#x27; || col.style.width===&#x27;0px&#x27;)return;
    visible.push(col);
   });
   if(visible.length){
    var width=(100/visible.length).toFixed(5)+&#x27;%&#x27;;
    visible.forEach(function(col){col.style.width=width; col.style.minWidth=&#x27;0&#x27;;});
   }
  });
 }

function renderTotals(){
 saveCurrent();
 const source=$(&#x27;tbl_STUDENT&#x27;), target=$(&#x27;aggTotalTable&#x27;);
 const summary=$(&#x27;aggSummary&#x27;);
 [&#x27;Center&#x27;,&#x27;Taluka&#x27;,&#x27;District&#x27;,&#x27;Udise&#x27;].forEach(k=&gt;{const input=$(&#x27;agg&#x27;+k);if(input&amp;&amp;input.value!==undefined)state.basic[k]=input.value.trim()});
 const valid=state.schools.filter(s=&gt;s.name.trim());
 summary.textContent=&#x27;केंद्राचे नाव : &#x27;+(state.basic.Center||&#x27;&#x27;)+&#x27; | तालुका : &#x27;+(state.basic.Taluka||&#x27;&#x27;)+&#x27; | जिल्हा : &#x27;+(state.basic.District||&#x27;&#x27;)+&#x27; | यु-डायस : &#x27;+(state.basic.Udise||&#x27;&#x27;)+&#x27; | एकूण शाळा : &#x27;+valid.length;
 // Copy the original student chart itself, retaining its labels, merged cells and geometry.
 const clone=source.cloneNode(true);
 clone.id=&#x27;aggOriginalStudentChart&#x27;;
 clone.removeAttribute(&#x27;contenteditable&#x27;);
 clone.querySelectorAll(&#x27;[contenteditable]&#x27;).forEach(el=&gt;el.removeAttribute(&#x27;contenteditable&#x27;));
 clone.querySelectorAll(&#x27;[id]&#x27;).forEach(el=&gt;el.removeAttribute(&#x27;id&#x27;));
 clone.querySelectorAll(&#x27;[data-pos]&#x27;).forEach(cell=&gt;{
   const pos=cell.dataset.pos;
   const st=/^ST-(9|1[0-8])-(B|G)$/.exec(pos||&#x27;&#x27;);
   if(st){
     let total=0,found=false;
     valid.forEach(school=&gt;{const value=num(state.data[school.id]?.STUDENT?.[pos]);if(value!==null){total+=value;found=true}});
     cell.textContent=found?String(total):&#x27;&#x27;;
     return;
   }
   const match=/^(\d+)-(\d+)$/.exec(pos||&#x27;&#x27;);
   if(!match)return;
   const r=+match[1],c=+match[2];
   if(r&gt;=9 &amp;&amp; r&lt;=18 &amp;&amp; c&gt;=4 &amp;&amp; c&lt;=52){
     let sum=0,found=false;
     valid.forEach(school=&gt;{const value=num(state.data[school.id]?.STUDENT?.[pos]);if(value!==null){sum+=value;found=true;}});
     cell.textContent=found?String(Math.round(sum*100000)/100000):&#x27;&#x27;;
   }
 });
 // For every editable numeric cell outside the class 1–8 table, show only actual school-entered values.
 clone.querySelectorAll(&#x27;[data-pos]&#x27;).forEach(cell=&gt;{
   const pos=cell.dataset.pos||&#x27;&#x27;;
   const match=/^(\d+)-(\d+)$/.exec(pos);
   if(!match)return;
   const r=+match[1],c=+match[2];
   if(r&gt;=9&amp;&amp;r&lt;=18&amp;&amp;c&gt;=4&amp;&amp;c&lt;=52)return;
   // All other data cells must not inherit the original school&#x27;s sample figures.
   if(r&gt;=9&amp;&amp;c&gt;=4){
     let total=0,found=false;
     valid.forEach(school=&gt;{const value=num(state.data[school.id]?.STUDENT?.[pos]);if(value!==null){total+=value;found=true}});
     cell.textContent=found?String(Math.round(total*100000)/100000):&#x27;&#x27;;
   }
 });
 // The printed center heading replaces school-specific titles; remove center-school name label.
 clone.querySelectorAll(&#x27;td,th&#x27;).forEach(cell=&gt;{
   const t=cell.textContent.trim();
   if(/^(केंद्र\s*शाळेचे\s*नाव|केंद्रशाळेचे\s*नाव)\s*[:：]?/.test(t))cell.textContent=&#x27;&#x27;;
   else if(/^(शाळेचे\s*नाव|शाळा\s*नाव)\s*[:：]?/.test(t))cell.textContent=state.basic.Center||&#x27;&#x27;;
 });
 // Keep the original chart&#x27;s visual structure and headings; only editable numeric data rows are aggregated.
 target.replaceWith(clone);
 clone.id=&#x27;aggTotalTable&#x27;;
}

function restore(data){if(!data)return;root().querySelectorAll(&#x27;[contenteditable],[data-extra]&#x27;).forEach(el=&gt;{const k=el.dataset.cell||&#x27;extra:&#x27;+el.dataset.extra;if(k in data){if(el.matches(&#x27;input&#x27;))el.value=data[k];else el.textContent=data[k]}});total()}
function save(){total();const data=snapshot();try{localStorage.setItem(key,JSON.stringify(data));const all=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key+&#x27;:schools&#x27;)||&#x27;{}&#x27;);const school=data[&#x27;extra:udise&#x27;]||data[&#x27;extra:school&#x27;]||&#x27;default&#x27;;all[school]=data;localStorage.setItem(key+&#x27;:schools&#x27;,JSON.stringify(all))}catch(e){alert(&#x27;माहिती जतन झाली नाही: &#x27;+e.message)}}
function aggregate(){let all={};try{all=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key+&#x27;:schools&#x27;)||&#x27;{}&#x27;)}catch(_){}const list=Object.values(all);const copy=grid().cloneNode(true);copy.removeAttribute(&#x27;id&#x27;);copy.querySelectorAll(&#x27;[contenteditable]&#x27;).forEach(el=&gt;{el.removeAttribute(&#x27;contenteditable&#x27;);const k=el.dataset.cell;el.textContent=String(list.reduce((sum,school)=&gt;sum+number(school[k]),0))});for(const [r,parts] of Object.entries(groups)){for(const k of [&#x27;sections&#x27;,...Array.from({length:40},(_,i)=&gt;Math.floor(i/2)+&#x27;-&#x27;+(i%2?&#x27;g&#x27;:&#x27;b&#x27;))]){const el=copy.querySelector(&#x27;[data-cell=&quot;&#x27;+r+&#x27;-&#x27;+k+&#x27;&quot;]&#x27;);if(el)el.textContent=String(parts.reduce((sum,i)=&gt;sum+number(copy.querySelector(&#x27;[data-cell=&quot;&#x27;+i+&#x27;-&#x27;+k+&#x27;&quot;]&#x27;)?.textContent),0))}}const target=document.getElementById(&#x27;gyNewAggregateGrid&#x27;);if(target)target.replaceChildren(copy);const count=document.getElementById(&#x27;gyNewAggregateCount&#x27;);if(count)count.textContent=&#x27;एकत्रित शाळा : &#x27;+list.length}
window.gyNewMonthlySave=save;window.gyNewMonthlyPrint=()=&gt;{save();document.body.classList.add(&#x27;gy-new-print&#x27;);window.print()};window.gyNewMonthlyAggregate=function(){
 let schools=[];try{schools=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(&#x27;gyanada_monthly_aggregation_v1&#x27;)||&#x27;{}&#x27;).schools||[]}catch(e){}
 let data={};try{data=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(&#x27;gyanada_schoolwise_excel_grid_v2&#x27;)||&#x27;{}&#x27;)}catch(e){}
 const valid=schools.filter(s=&gt;String(s.name||&#x27;&#x27;).trim());const copy=grid()?.cloneNode(true);if(!copy)return;copy.removeAttribute(&#x27;id&#x27;);
 const numeric=x=&gt;{const v=String(x??&#x27;&#x27;).trim();return /^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(v)?Number(v):null};
 copy.querySelectorAll(&#x27;[data-cell]&#x27;).forEach(el=&gt;{const k=el.dataset.cell;const values=valid.map(s=&gt;numeric(data[String(s.id)]?.[k])).filter(v=&gt;v!==null);if(el.matches(&#x27;[contenteditable]&#x27;)){el.removeAttribute(&#x27;contenteditable&#x27;);el.textContent=values.length?String(values.reduce((a,b)=&gt;a+b,0)):&#x27;&#x27;}});
 const target=document.getElementById(&#x27;gyNewAggregateGrid&#x27;);if(target)target.replaceChildren(copy);
 const count=document.getElementById(&#x27;gyNewAggregateCount&#x27;);if(count)count.textContent=&#x27;एकत्रित शाळा : &#x27;+valid.filter(s=&gt;data[String(s.id)]&amp;&amp;Object.keys(data[String(s.id)]).length).length+&#x27; / &#x27;+valid.length;
};
function init(){const old=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)||&#x27;null&#x27;);restore(old);grid()?.addEventListener(&#x27;input&#x27;,total);const nav=document.getElementById(&#x27;monthlyOriginalNav&#x27;);if(nav&amp;&amp;!nav.querySelector(&#x27;[data-gy-page=&quot;student&quot;]&#x27;)){const b=document.createElement(&#x27;button&#x27;);b.type=&#x27;button&#x27;;b.dataset.gyPage=&#x27;student&#x27;;b.textContent=&#x27;पान १ — विद्यार्थी माहिती&#x27;;b.onclick=()=&gt;window.monthlyPage?.(&#x27;STUDENT&#x27;);nav.prepend(b)}const oldPage=window.monthlyPage;window.monthlyPage=function(n){if(typeof oldPage===&#x27;function&#x27;)oldPage.apply(this,arguments);document.body.classList.toggle(&#x27;gy-monthly-student-active&#x27;,n===&#x27;STUDENT&#x27;)};const oldDash=window.monthlyDashboard;window.monthlyDashboard=function(n){if(typeof oldDash===&#x27;function&#x27;)oldDash.apply(this,arguments);document.body.classList.toggle(&#x27;gy-monthly-student-active&#x27;,n===&#x27;original&#x27;)};const oldAgg=window.aggregateTab;window.aggregateTab=function(n){if(typeof oldAgg===&#x27;function&#x27;)oldAgg.apply(this,arguments);if(n===&#x27;totals&#x27;)aggregate()};document.body.classList.add(&#x27;gy-monthly-student-active&#x27;);total()}
if(document.readyState===&#x27;loading&#x27;)document.addEventListener(&#x27;DOMContentLoaded&#x27;,init);else init();
})();
